notes.title: Third Update for Skelittle: A Giant Party!! Patch note v1.4
notes.content:

Dash function have been uniformized for all minigames

Adds Giant Party Launcher : Now, you can launch the party you want !

Minigames :

HeliSlicing : 
Adds Dash animation 
Adds character voices
Adds vibrations 
New system for blade rotation at start to avoid spawn kill

Bash in Bath : 
New ambiant SFX

Water Sprinkler :
New environment 
Improvement of the water bomb’s position
Improvement of the movement system
Life number have been reduced to 3

New environment

New music & new music system

Amelioration of the SFX mix

notes.title: First Update for Skelittle: A Giant Party!! Patch note v1.2
notes.content:
First Update for Skelittle: A Giant Party!! Patch note v1.2
You guys will find a variety of improvement and enjoy an even better user experience !


Global : 
Reduction of the countdown size
New minigames logos
French translation
Mixed Music

The Stash :
Bug Fixed : Players can go out by the top of the stash
Two less lines on the Grid
Reset Stash Objects
Stash Library reset
Unique user for The Stash tutorial
New camera position
New level design
New grid texture for edit mode

Team Rewards :
Progression system activated (level 7)
Add the first Achievements

Minigames :

Tutorials : 
Can be reached from the pause menu

Midnight Hunting : 
Shooting system fixed
New position of the camera
Bug fixed : mosquitos spawn
Amelioration of the mosquitos movements
New meshes for mosquitos, fireflies & projectile
New sights 
Feedback when you hit a mosquito

Steal & Escape : 
Bug fixed : players passing through the colliders 
Goal to reach more readable (score/5)

Raft Racing : 
Camera scroll fixed
Bug Fixed : Scroll trigger issues
Music integrated

Rob The Dog :
Bug fixed : Characters staying in “Dash” animation
Bug fixed : Animations of the dog not synchronized with the gameplay
Bug fixed : Music not synchronized with the gameplay
